subject: Audit logging capabilities - follow-up & next steps

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: 
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Audit logging capabilities - follow-up & next steps

Hi Olivia / Acme security team,

Great speaking with you earlier today  thanks for taking the time to walk through your requirements. As promised, a quick recap of what we covered and the next steps so everyone is aligned: 

Key capability notes (Redwood):
- Admin activity logs: detailed records of console actions (user, action, timestamp, resource) with role context.
- API request logs: per-request metadata including client_id, model, prompt size, latency, and returned token counts.
- Exportability: logs can be exported on-demand or scheduled (CSV/NDJSON) to your S3 or shared Drive.
- Immutability / retention: write-once append logs with retention policies (configurable per account). We support tamper-evident SHA256 checksums for exported batches.
- Access controls: log access governed by RBAC + audit trails for access to logs themselves.

Compliance items we discussed:
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report (summary attached) and a SOC scoping doc we can share with your security team.
- GDPR/HIPAA: data residency controls available; PHI access controls and BAAs are supported  we can route a short compliance checklist to legal.

Attachments included in this message: audit_log_sample.csv (sample export), redwood_audit_logging_faq.pdf (short FAQ).

Proposed next steps:
1) Olivia: please send the Acme vendor security questionnaire (or a link) and flag any must-have fields.
2) Marissa: I will coordinate with our security team to fill the questionnaire and provide SOC artifacts.
3) Schedule a 30-min deep-dive demo of the audit log export + retention flow (suggested window: next week).

If you want to hand this to your security contact, feel free  happy to include our security lead on the follow-up.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa  happy to take this. Quick answers that I will include in the questionnaire and attach the SOC artifacts: 

- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report covering 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. I will attach the SOC2-summary.pdf (redacted) and provide the auditor contact if Acme needs direct validation.
- Immutability: audit logs are stored in append-only storage with write-once semantics internally; exported batches include SHA256 checksums and an exported manifest you can validate. We'll include standard language and a sample manifest with the export.
- Retention/export: default retention is 90 days for API logs, configurable up to multi-year for admin/legal accounts. Customers can configure scheduled exports to their S3 (we support AWS roles) or get one-off exports (CSV/NDJSON).
- PHI/BAA: we do support BAAs for HIPAA workflows; need legal sign-off  I'll loop in legal if Acme wants a BAA.

I attached SOC2-summary.pdf and will prepare the sample export and manifest (audit_log_sample.csv + manifest). Happy to join the call next week  what times does Acme prefer?
